title: Lowleaf Hollow - The Hollow Sleeps
_note: Option B mood sibling, town-leaning. gbc 4-voice band. 3/4 waltz, 84bpm, warm G major with a gentle minor turn (E minor / C). Rounded pulse25 music-box lullaby melody, cosier and more tuneful than A; pulse12 soft music-box arpeggio, slow and even, hearth not glass; tri_bass gentle waltz root-fall-fifth rocking warm; soft drums brush on beats 2-3, a single chime per phrase. Vesper as the lullaby hook in lilting 3/4: lift D4->G4->A4, settle B4->A4->G4, rounded and even - the cosy 'you're home' reading. 20 bars in 3/4; each bar = 3 quarters; last bar voice-leads home.

tracks.name: lead
tracks._note: Rounded music-box lullaby. Vesper as the waltz hook: lift D4->G4->A4, settle B4->A4->G4. A gentle minor turn (Em) in the bridge.
